name: Dumbbell Shrug
summary: A shrug with dumbbells at the sides that loads the upper traps and lets the hands hang in a natural position.
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep the chest up, the abs braced and the head neutral.
Let the shoulders hang relaxed with straight arms.
execution: Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears.
Squeeze and pause at the top.
Lower slowly to a full relaxed hang.
Keep the arms straight and the torso still.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles: move straight up and down.
Using momentum from the legs: stand still and slow down.
Neck jutting forward: keep the head stacked over the shoulders.
Grip failing first: use straps on the heaviest sets.
